subject: Quant

questions.q: $ABCD$ is a rectangle with sides $AB = 56$ cm and $BC = 45$ cm, and $E$ is the midpoint of side $CD$. Then, the length, in cm, of the radius of the incircle of $\Delta ADE$ is
questions.explain: In rectangle ABCD, $AD = BC = 45$, and $CD = AB = 56$. $E$ is the midpoint of $CD$, so $DE = 56 / 2 = 28$. $\Delta ADE$ is a right-angled triangle at $D$. The legs are $AD = 45$ and $DE = 28$. The hypotenuse $AE = \sqrt{45^2 + 28^2} = \sqrt{2025 + 784} = \sqrt{2809} = 53$. The radius of the incircle of a right triangle is $r = \frac{\text{leg}_1 + \text{leg}_2 - \text{hypotenuse}}{2} = \frac{45 + 28 - 53}{2} = \frac{20}{2} = 10$ cm.
